learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with experience and knowledge of technical English.
Make students ready to use English sources of information for later study and professional career.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of technical English (for pre-intermediate and intermediate students)
Technical English for mathematics (for advanced students)
Technical English for physics (for advanced students)
Technical English for computer science (for advanced students)
English for management and economic and financial mathematics (for advanced students)
assessment_rules: Grades are given as follows: A 93%, B 85%, C 77%, D 70%, E 65%. The scale of assessment is preliminary/final: 100/0.
